metadata.serviceFullName: AWS Network Security Manager Customer API

CreateDeployment.name: CreateDeployment
CreateDeployment.documentation: Creates a deployment. A deployment applies one or more policies to the accounts and resources selected by a scope. Use isPublished to create the deployment in published (ACTIVE) or draft (DRAFT) state. The response includes coverage information and any warnings about the deployment.

CreateDeploymentSnapshot.name: CreateDeploymentSnapshot
CreateDeploymentSnapshot.documentation: Creates a snapshot of the current published version of the specified deployment.

CreatePolicy.name: CreatePolicy
CreatePolicy.documentation: Creates a policy. A policy combines templates and rules with enforcement settings for a firewall type, such as AWS WAF or AWS Shield Advanced. Use isPublished to create the policy in published (ACTIVE) or draft (DRAFT) state.

CreatePolicySnapshot.name: CreatePolicySnapshot
CreatePolicySnapshot.documentation: Creates a snapshot of the current published version of the specified policy.

CreateRule.name: CreateRule
CreateRule.documentation: Creates a rule. A rule defines a network security configuration to enforce, such as an AWS WAF rule group or configuration data. Use isPublished to create the rule in published (ACTIVE) or draft (DRAFT) state.

CreateRuleSnapshot.name: CreateRuleSnapshot
CreateRuleSnapshot.documentation: Creates a snapshot of the current published version of the specified rule. A snapshot is an immutable, versioned copy that other resources can reference.

CreateScope.name: CreateScope
CreateScope.documentation: Creates a scope. A scope selects the accounts and resources that a deployment applies to. Use isPublished to create the scope in published (ACTIVE) or draft (DRAFT) state.

CreateScopeSnapshot.name: CreateScopeSnapshot
CreateScopeSnapshot.documentation: Creates a snapshot of the current published version of the specified scope.

CreateTemplate.name: CreateTemplate
CreateTemplate.documentation: Creates a template. A template groups one or more rules to simplify reuse across policies. You can also associate rules with a policy directly, without a template. Use isPublished to create the template in published (ACTIVE) or draft (DRAFT) state.

CreateTemplateSnapshot.name: CreateTemplateSnapshot
CreateTemplateSnapshot.documentation: Creates a snapshot of the current published version of the specified template.

DeleteAdminAccount.name: DeleteAdminAccount
DeleteAdminAccount.documentation: Removes the specified AWS Network Security Manager administrator account.

GenerateRuleConfiguration.name: GenerateRuleConfiguration
GenerateRuleConfiguration.documentation: Generates a rule configuration from a natural-language description. Provide a prompt along with the rule's firewall type and rule type. The service returns a configuration that you can use when you create or update a rule. If you also provide an existing configuration, the service edits that configuration instead of generating a new one.

GetAdminAccount.name: GetAdminAccount
GetAdminAccount.documentation: Retrieves the details of the specified AWS Network Security Manager administrator account.

GetDeployment.name: GetDeployment
GetDeployment.documentation: Retrieves the details of the specified deployment, including coverage information and any warnings.

GetPolicy.name: GetPolicy
GetPolicy.documentation: Retrieves the details of the specified policy.

GetRule.name: GetRule
GetRule.documentation: Retrieves the details of the specified rule.

GetScope.name: GetScope
GetScope.documentation: Retrieves the details of the specified scope.

GetTemplate.name: GetTemplate
GetTemplate.documentation: Retrieves the details of the specified template.

ListAdminAccounts.name: ListAdminAccounts
ListAdminAccounts.documentation: Lists the AWS Network Security Manager administrator accounts in the organization.

ListAggregateResourceSynchronizationStat.name: ListAggregateResourceSynchronizationStatuses
ListAggregateResourceSynchronizationStat.documentation: Lists the aggregated synchronization statuses of resources across the deployments in your administrator account. You can filter the results by synchronization status and page through them.

ListDeploymentSnapshots.name: ListDeploymentSnapshots
ListDeploymentSnapshots.documentation: Lists the snapshots of the specified deployment.

ListDeployments.name: ListDeployments
ListDeployments.documentation: Lists the deployments in the account. You can filter the results by status and page through them using maxResults and nextToken.

ListPolicies.name: ListPolicies
ListPolicies.documentation: Lists the policies in the account. You can filter the results by status and page through them using maxResults and nextToken.

ListPolicySnapshots.name: ListPolicySnapshots
ListPolicySnapshots.documentation: Lists the snapshots of the specified policy.

ListResourceAssociations.name: ListResourceAssociations
ListResourceAssociations.documentation: Lists the resources associated with the specified resource.

ListResourceSynchronizationStatuses.name: ListResourceSynchronizationStatuses
ListResourceSynchronizationStatuses.documentation: Lists the synchronization statuses of the resources covered by the specified deployment. You can filter the results by synchronization status and page through them.

ListRuleSnapshots.name: ListRuleSnapshots
ListRuleSnapshots.documentation: Lists the snapshots of the specified rule.

ListRules.name: ListRules
ListRules.documentation: Lists the rules in the account. You can filter the results by status and page through them using maxResults and nextToken.

ListScopeSnapshots.name: ListScopeSnapshots
ListScopeSnapshots.documentation: Lists the snapshots of the specified scope.

ListScopes.name: ListScopes
ListScopes.documentation: Lists the scopes in the account. You can filter the results by status and page through them using maxResults and nextToken.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation: Lists the tags associated with the specified resource.

ListTemplateSnapshots.name: ListTemplateSnapshots
ListTemplateSnapshots.documentation: Lists the snapshots of the specified template.

ListTemplates.name: ListTemplates
ListTemplates.documentation: Lists the templates in the account. You can filter the results by status and page through them using maxResults and nextToken.

PutAdminAccount.name: PutAdminAccount
PutAdminAccount.documentation:
Sets the AWS account that serves as an AWS Network Security Manager administrator account, and optionally configures the scope of resources that the administrator can manage.

You can't set an administrator account again immediately after you remove it, or while the service creates its service-linked role. Retry the request after a few minutes.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.documentation: Adds or overwrites the specified tags on the given resource.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.documentation: Removes the specified tags from the given resource.

UpdateDeployment.name: UpdateDeployment
UpdateDeployment.documentation: Updates the specified deployment. To prevent conflicting concurrent updates, provide the current updateToken. Use isPublished to publish the update or keep the deployment as a draft.

UpdatePolicy.name: UpdatePolicy
UpdatePolicy.documentation: Updates the specified policy. To prevent conflicting concurrent updates, provide the current updateToken. Use isPublished to publish the update or keep the policy as a draft.

UpdateRule.name: UpdateRule
UpdateRule.documentation: Updates the specified rule. To prevent conflicting concurrent updates, provide the current updateToken. Use isPublished to publish the update or keep the rule as a draft.

UpdateScope.name: UpdateScope
UpdateScope.documentation: Updates the specified scope. To prevent conflicting concurrent updates, provide the current updateToken. Use isPublished to publish the update or keep the scope as a draft.

UpdateTemplate.name: UpdateTemplate
UpdateTemplate.documentation: Updates the specified template. To prevent conflicting concurrent updates, provide the current updateToken. Use isPublished to publish the update or keep the template as a draft.

The account filter that determines which accounts are in scope. When set, exactly one of includeAll, include, or exclude is set.

Organization administrators must include an account filter in every scope configuration. Single-account administrators must omit it: a scope without an account filter applies only to the administrator's own account. The presence of an account filter is fixed when the scope is created: an update can't add an account filter to a scope that was created without one, or remove the account filter from a scope that was created with one.

documentation:
AWS Network Security Manager helps you centrally configure and deploy network security protections across your organization. Supported protections include AWS WAF and AWS Shield Advanced. This centralized approach reduces the overhead of managing protections individually across accounts and ensures consistent security at scale.

You define reusable rules and templates, then combine them into policies. Next, you select the accounts and resources to protect with scopes and roll the protections out with deployments. For example, you can define a set of AWS WAF rules and group them into a policy. Then deploy that policy across all accounts in your organization with a single deployment.

This API reference describes the operations and data types for AWS Network Security Manager.

For conceptual information, tutorials, and guidance on writing rule configurations, see the AWS Network Security Manager Developer Guide. For the default quotas that apply to your account, see Quotas. For the service endpoints available in each Region, see AWS Network Security Manager endpoints and quotas in the AWS General Reference.
